title: Mga Pista Opisyal at Espesyal na Araw ng Pilipinas (1988–2030)
description: Philippine regular holidays (mga regular na pista opisyal) and special (non-working / working) days from 1988 (first full year under the Revised Administrative Code / Executive Order 292/1987) through 2030, in two categories: PUBLIC (non-working regular and special holidays such as Bagong Taon — New Year's Day, Bagong Taon ng mga Tsino — Chinese New Year, Araw ng Kagitingan — Day of Valor, Huwebes Santo / Biyernes Santo — Maundy Thursday and Good Friday, Sabado de Gloria — Black Saturday, Araw ng Paggawa — Labor Day, Araw ng Kalayaan — Independence Day, Eid'l Fitr / Eid'l Adha — Islamic feast days proclaimed annually, Araw ng Kabayanihan ni Ninoy Aquino — Ninoy Aquino Day, Araw ng mga Bayani — National Heroes Day, Araw ng mga Santo — All Saints' Day, Araw ng Kabayanihan ni Bonifacio — Bonifacio Day, Pasko — Christmas Day, Araw ng Kabayanihan ni Rizal — Rizal Day) and WORKDAY (special working days such as Anibersaryo ng Rebolusyon sa EDSA — EDSA People Power Revolution Anniversary, Bisperas ng Araw ng mga Santo — All Saints' Day Eve, Bisperas ng Pasko — Christmas Eve, Bisperas ng Bagong Taon — Last Day of the Year). Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation in holidays/countries/philippines.py, which cites EO 292/1987 (Revised Administrative Code), RA 9177/2002 (Eid'l Fitr), RA 9256/2004 (Araw ng Kabayanihan ni Bonifacio), RA 9492/2007 (Holiday Economics — movable holidays), RA 9645/2009 (Eid'l Adha), RA 9849/2009 (Eid'l Adha codified), RA 10966/2017 (Feast of the Immaculate Conception), and recurring Presidential Proclamations. Multilingual names in Filipino (fil, native Tagalog), English-Philippines (en_PH, default upstream), English-US (en_US) and Thai (th).

meta.description: Philippine regular holidays (mga regular na pista opisyal) and special (non-working / working) days from 1988 (first full year under the Revised Administrative Code / Executive Order 292/1987) through 2030, in two categories: PUBLIC (non-working regular and special holidays such as Bagong Taon — New Year's Day, Bagong Taon ng mga Tsino — Chinese New Year, Araw ng Kagitingan — Day of Valor, Huwebes Santo / Biyernes Santo — Maundy Thursday and Good Friday, Sabado de Gloria — Black Saturday, Araw ng Paggawa — Labor Day, Araw ng Kalayaan — Independence Day, Eid'l Fitr / Eid'l Adha — Islamic feast days proclaimed annually, Araw ng Kabayanihan ni Ninoy Aquino — Ninoy Aquino Day, Araw ng mga Bayani — National Heroes Day, Araw ng mga Santo — All Saints' Day, Araw ng Kabayanihan ni Bonifacio — Bonifacio Day, Pasko — Christmas Day, Araw ng Kabayanihan ni Rizal — Rizal Day) and WORKDAY (special working days such as Anibersaryo ng Rebolusyon sa EDSA — EDSA People Power Revolution Anniversary, Bisperas ng Araw ng mga Santo — All Saints' Day Eve, Bisperas ng Pasko — Christmas Eve, Bisperas ng Bagong Taon — Last Day of the Year). Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation in holidays/countries/philippines.py, which cites EO 292/1987 (Revised Administrative Code), RA 9177/2002 (Eid'l Fitr), RA 9256/2004 (Araw ng Kabayanihan ni Bonifacio), RA 9492/2007 (Holiday Economics — movable holidays), RA 9645/2009 (Eid'l Adha), RA 9849/2009 (Eid'l Adha codified), RA 10966/2017 (Feast of the Immaculate Conception), and recurring Presidential Proclamations. Multilingual names in Filipino (fil, native Tagalog), English-Philippines (en_PH, default upstream), English-US (en_US) and Thai (th). Naglalaman ng 708 talaan. I-download sa Excel, CSV, PDF format.
